test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Which of the following will fill blank no (1)
solution:
The correct answer is '**personalized**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights how digital tools make learning more accessible and tailored to individual needs.
 
• The blank requires a word that describes learning experiences suited to each student.
 
• "**Personalized**" accurately conveys that learning can be adapted to each learner’s pace and style, matching the passage’s context.
 
• Other options ("**demanding**", "**expensive**", "**structured**") do not align with the idea of customized or individualized learning experiences.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Passage Excerpt: *Online platforms, interactive modules, and virtual classrooms have made learning more accessible and **personalized__** for students around the world.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Demanding: Suggests something that requires a lot of effort, not suitable for the given context.
 
• Expensive: Indicates high cost, which does not match the passage’s emphasis on accessibility.
 
• Structured: Means organized, but does not capture the sense of learning being tailored to the individual.
